---
title: "Mobile TOC dark scheme without tertiary background"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    theme:
      light: flatly
      dark: darkly
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <style>:root, [data-bs-theme], body { --bs-tertiary-bg: initial; }</style>
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['id="mobile-toc-options"']
        - []
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: node _checks/layout-check.mjs "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" dark-fallback && node _checks/axe-check.mjs "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" dark-fallback
---
